description: Defines an abstract base class for secret management implementations, including methods for reading, writing, deleting, and rotating secrets asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: BaseSecretManager
classes.description: Abstract base class for secret management implementations, providing method signatures for secret operations.

methods.name: async_read_secret
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously read a secret from the secret manager.

methods.name: sync_read_secret
methods.description: Abstract method to synchronously read a secret from the secret manager.

methods.name: async_write_secret
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously write a secret to the secret manager.

methods.name: async_delete_secret
methods.description: Abstract method to asynchronously delete a secret from the secret manager.

methods.name: async_rotate_secret
methods.description: Method to rotate a secret by creating a new one and deleting the old, with error handling and verification.
